note: Ps77 remembrance-lament (Asaph). Human IB harvest: CRY + SEEK; the SOUL that REFUSES to be COMFORTED (v2); REMEMBER God + MOAN + MEDITATE, the SPIRIT that FAINTS (v3); so TROUBLED I cannot speak (v4); CONSIDER the days of old (v5); night REMEMBER/MEDITATE, SPIRIT'S diligent SEARCH (v6); the pivot 'this is my APPEAL/grief' (v10); resolve to REMEMBER/PONDER/MEDITATE God's deeds (v11-12). The doubting questions name GOD's attributes (steadfast-love/gracious/anger/compassion/favor = qualifiers). Theophany v16-20 (waters saw+afraid, deep trembled, thunder/whirlwind/lightnings, God's path through sea) = standalone.

dims.v: cry out (tsaaq - I cry aloud to God)
to God, that he may hear
paired with seeking the Lord in trouble (v2)

'I CRY (tsaaq) aloud to God, aloud to God, and he will hear me' - the loud, urgent appeal that opens the lament; tsaaq here the cry of distress lifted to God, the voice of a soul in the day of trouble reaching for the one who hears
the Lord, in the day of trouble
hand stretched out untiring through the night
paired with the soul that refuses comfort

'In the day of my trouble I SEEK (darash) the Lord; in the night my hand is stretched out without wearying' - the persistent, untiring pursuit of God in distress; darash here the resolute seeking that keeps reaching even when comfort is refused
soul / self (nephesh - my soul refuses to be comforted)
paired with the refusing and the comfort refused
'my SOUL (nephesh) refuses to be comforted' - the whole inner self, the seat of grief; nephesh here the disconsolate self that will not be soothed, the depth of the lament located in the soul itself
paired with the soul and the comfort refused
'my soul REFUSES (maen) to be comforted' - the active turning-away from consolation; maen here the grief so deep it declines to be eased, a refusal that measures the weight of the distress
'refuses to be COMFORTED (nacham)' - the consolation the soul will not accept; nacham here the relief held at arm's length, comfort named only to be declined - the shape of unassuageable grief
remember (zakar - I remember God and moan)
paired with moaning and the fainting spirit

'When I REMEMBER (zakar) God, I moan' - the paradox that memory of God brings not solace but anguish here; zakar in the distress-phase, remembrance that deepens the groan rather than lifting it (contrast v11 where remembering becomes the turn to hope)
'I remember God, and I MOAN (hamah)' - the audible groan of the troubled heart; hamah here the low murmur of distress, grief given voice as the mind dwells on God in the dark

'I MEDITATE (siach), and my spirit faints' - the brooding, complaining musing of the sleepless night; siach here the inward turning-over of grief that exhausts rather than settles, driving the spirit to faintness
'my SPIRIT (ruach) faints' - the animating inner self worn to weakness; ruach here the spirit drained by unrelieved grief, the inner vitality collapsing under the weight of the night's musing
faint / grow feeble (ataph - my spirit faints)
paired with the spirit that it overwhelms
'my spirit FAINTS (ataph)' - the swooning collapse of the inner self; ataph here the feebleness that overtakes the spirit, the point where grief exhausts the very capacity to bear it
be troubled / agitated (paam - I am so troubled)
paired with the sleepless eyes God holds open
'I am so TROUBLED (paam) that I cannot speak' - the agitation that robs even words; paam here the inner disturbance so severe it leaves the sufferer mute, grief past the reach of speech
consider / reckon (chashab - I consider the days of old)
the days of old, the years long ago

'I CONSIDER (chashab) the days of old, the years long ago' - the mind turning back to former times; chashab here the deliberate reckoning-up of the past, the sufferer searching history for evidence that God has not always been silent
remember (zakar - I remember my song in the night)
paired with meditating and the spirit's search

'I REMEMBER (zakar) my song in the night' - recalling former nights of praise now turned to grief; zakar here the memory of a happier melody, summoned in the sleepless dark as the heart searches for what was lost
meditate / muse (siach - I meditate with my heart)
a diligent search of the spirit
paired with the spirit's diligent search

'I MEDITATE (siach) with my heart, and my spirit made a diligent search' - the inward communing of the heart; siach here the nocturnal self-examination, the heart talking with itself as the spirit probes for an answer
spirit (ruach - my spirit made a diligent search)

'my SPIRIT (ruach) made a diligent search' - the inner self actively probing; ruach here the searching faculty (contrast the fainting spirit of v3) - grief become inquiry, the spirit interrogating its own experience for God
paired with the spirit that performs it

'my spirit made a diligent SEARCH (chaphas)' - the thorough probing that issues in the six anxious questions of v7-9; chaphas here the deep self-searching, the mind ransacking itself: has God forever spurned, forgotten, shut up his compassion?
grief / my appeal (challothi - this is my grief)
name the grief / resolve to appeal
the changed right hand of the Most High
paired with the resolve to remember God's deeds (v11)

'Then I said, This is my GRIEF (challothi): that the right hand of the Most High has changed' - the hinge of the psalm, where the sufferer names his wound and, in naming it, pivots from questioning God's silence toward remembering his deeds; grief spoken becomes the doorway to hope
remember (zakar - I will remember the deeds of the LORD)
the deeds and wonders of the LORD
paired with the second remember and the pondering

'I will REMEMBER (zakar) the deeds of the LORD' - the decisive act of will that turns the psalm; zakar here memory chosen as remedy, the sufferer deliberately recalling God's works to answer his own despairing questions - remembrance now healing where in v3 it wounded
remember (zakar - I will remember your wonders)
paired with the first resolve to remember

'yes, I will REMEMBER (zakar) your wonders of old' - the doubled resolve, memory pressed home; zakar repeated to fix the will on God's ancient wonders (the Exodus, v16-20), the deliberate rehearsal that steadies faith
ponder / muse (hagah - I will ponder all your work)
paired with meditating on God's mighty deeds

'I will PONDER (hagah) all your work' - the murmuring rehearsal of God's doings; hagah here the low, dwelling meditation (the same word for the righteous musing on the law, Ps 1:2) now trained on God's deeds to feed a fainting faith
meditate (siach - and meditate on your mighty deeds)

'and MEDITATE (siach) on your mighty deeds' - the same musing that in v3 exhausted the spirit now redirected to God's mighty acts; siach here meditation converted from complaint into contemplation of God's power, the cure using the very faculty that had ached
hear / give ear (azan - and he will hear me)
God's hearing, the hope that grounds the crying out
v1 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'aloud to God, and he will HEAR (azan) me' - God's hearing is not a human IB char; the confidence that grounds the cry (282861). Qualifier.
hold / grasp (achaz - you hold my eyelids open)
God's holding the eyes open, cause of the sleepless agitation
v4 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'You HOLD (achaz) my eyelids open' - God keeping the sufferer awake is not a human IB char; the divine cause of the sleepless trouble (306738). Qualifier.
spurn / reject (zanach - will the Lord spurn forever?)
the feared divine rejection the search interrogates
v7 QUALIFIER (God's disposition, feared): 'Will the Lord SPURN (zanach) forever?' - God's rejecting is not a human IB char; the dreaded possibility the spirit's search (282978) probes. Qualifier.
be favorable / accept (ratsah - never again be favorable?)
God's favour, whose withdrawal the sufferer fears
v7 QUALIFIER (God's disposition, re-roled): 'and never again be FAVORABLE (ratsah)?' - God's favour is not a human IB char; the acceptance the anxious question fears is lost. Qualifier.
steadfast love (chesed - has his steadfast love forever ceased?)
God's chesed, whose feared cessation drives the lament
v8 QUALIFIER (God's attribute): 'Has his STEADFAST LOVE (chesed) forever ceased?' - God's covenant love is not a human IB char; the attribute the sufferer fears has ended. Qualifier.
forget (shakach - has God forgotten to be gracious?)
God's feared forgetting, object of the anxious search
v9 QUALIFIER (God's act, feared): 'Has God FORGOTTEN (shakach) to be gracious?' - God's forgetting is not a human IB char; the dreaded lapse the question voices. Qualifier.
be gracious (chanan - forgotten to be gracious)
v9 QUALIFIER (God's attribute): 'forgotten to be GRACIOUS (chanan)' - God's grace is not a human IB char; the mercy the sufferer fears is forgotten. Qualifier.
anger (aph - has he in anger shut up his compassion?)
God's anger, feared to have closed off compassion
v9 QUALIFIER (God's disposition): 'Has he in ANGER (aph) shut up his compassion?' - God's anger is not a human IB char; the wrath the sufferer fears has sealed off mercy. Qualifier.
compassion / mercy (racham - shut up his compassion)
God's compassion, feared shut up in anger
v9 QUALIFIER (God's attribute): 'shut up his COMPASSION (racham)' - God's tender mercy is not a human IB char; the compassion the sufferer fears is withheld. Qualifier.
deeds (maalal - the deeds of the LORD)
the LORD's deeds, what the psalmist resolves to remember
v11 QUALIFIER (God's works): 'I will remember the DEEDS (maalal) of the LORD' - God's deeds are not a human IB char; the works the psalmist recalls (282875). Qualifier.
wonders (pele - I will remember your wonders)
God's wonders of old, object of the remembering
v11 QUALIFIER (God's works): 'I will remember your WONDERS (pele) of old' - God's wonders are not a human IB char; the marvels recalled (282879). Qualifier.
God's work, what the psalmist ponders
v12 QUALIFIER (God's works): 'I will ponder all your WORK (poal)' - God's work is not a human IB char; the doing the psalmist muses on (282884). Qualifier.
mighty deeds (alilah - meditate on your mighty deeds)
God's mighty deeds, object of the meditation
v12 QUALIFIER (God's works): 'meditate on your MIGHTY DEEDS (alilah)' - God's mighty acts are not a human IB char; the deeds meditated on (282887). Qualifier.
holy / holiness (qodesh - your way is holy)
God's holiness, the ground of the wonders remembered
v13 QUALIFIER (God's attribute): 'Your way, O God, is HOLY (qodesh)' - God's holiness is not a human IB char; the sacred character of his way. Qualifier.
do wonders (ele - the God who works wonders)
God's wonder-working, ground of the meditation
v14 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'You are the God who WORKS (asah) wonders' - God's working is not a human IB char; his marvel-doing. Qualifier.
wonder (pele - the God who works wonders)
God's wonders, made known among the peoples
v14 QUALIFIER (God's works): 'the God who works WONDERS (pele)' - God's wonders are not a human IB char; his marvellous acts. Qualifier.
make known (yada - you have made known your might)
God's self-manifestation of might among the peoples
v14 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'you have made KNOWN (yada) your might among the peoples' - God's making-known is not a human IB char; his revealed power. Qualifier.
might / strength (oz - your might among the peoples)
God's might, made known among the nations
v14 QUALIFIER (God's attribute): 'your MIGHT (oz) among the peoples' - God's power is not a human IB char; the strength he displays. Qualifier.
arm (zeroa - with your arm you redeemed)
God's arm, the strength by which he redeemed
v15 QUALIFIER (God's power): 'You with your ARM (zeroa) redeemed your people' - God's arm is not a human IB char; the mighty strength of the redemption. Qualifier.
God's redemption of his people, the wonder remembered
v15 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'you REDEEMED (gaal) your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph' - God's redeeming is not a human IB char; the Exodus deliverance recalled. Qualifier.
lead / guide (nachah - you led your people)
God's leading of his people, climax of the remembered redemption

v20 QUALIFIER (God's act): 'You LED (nachah) your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron' - God's shepherd-leading is not a human IB char; the guidance that crowns the Exodus recital. Qualifier.
v1: 'I cry ALOUD (qol) to God' - the raised voice of the cry; manner of the appeal (the char cry, 282861). Standalone.
v1: 'ALOUD (qol) to God' - the repeated raised voice; manner of the cry. Standalone.
trouble / distress (tsarah - the day of my trouble)
v2: 'In the day of my TROUBLE (tsarah) I seek the Lord' - the distress that occasions the seeking; the circumstance framing the lament. Standalone (circumstance).
stretch out / pour (nagar - my hand is stretched out)
v2: 'in the night my hand is STRETCHED OUT (nagar) without wearying' - the outstretched, imploring hand of prayer; gesture of the untiring seeking (the char, 282941). Standalone (gesture).
v2: 'without WEARYING (pug)' - the tirelessness of the outstretched hand; manner of the persistent seeking. Standalone (manner).
eyelids / watches (shemurah - you hold my eyelids open)
v4: 'You hold my eyelids (shemurah) OPEN' - the sleepless eyes God holds; image of the wakeful night. Standalone (image).
v4: 'I am so troubled that I cannot SPEAK (dabar)' - the speechlessness of overwhelming grief; the muteness that measures the trouble (the char, 306738). Standalone (the failed speech).
years / long ago (olam - the years long ago)
v5: 'the YEARS LONG AGO (olam)' - the ancient times the sufferer considers; temporal object of the considering (the char, 282966). Standalone (temporal).
heart (lebab - I meditate with my heart)
v6: 'I meditate with my HEART (lebab)' - the heart as the seat of the night meditation (captured in the char meditate, 282974); the inner chamber of the musing. Standalone (seat).
forever (olam - will the Lord spurn forever?)
v7: 'Will the Lord spurn FOREVER (olam)?' - the dreaded permanence of the rejection; temporal edge of the anxious question. Standalone (temporal).
again / add (yasaph - never again be favorable)
v7: 'and never AGAIN (yasaph) be favorable?' - the feared finality, that favour will not return; the temporal force of the doubt. Standalone (temporal).
cease / come to an end (aphes - has his steadfast love ceased?)
v8: 'Has his steadfast love forever CEASED (aphes)?' - the feared ending of chesed; the term of the anxious question. Standalone (the feared cessation).
come to an end (gamar - are his promises at an end?)
v8: 'Are his promises at an END (gamar) for all time?' - the feared expiry of God's word; the object of the doubt. Standalone (the feared end).
shut up / restrain (qaphats - shut up his compassion)
v9: 'Has he in anger SHUT UP (qaphats) his compassion?' - the feared closing-off of mercy; the act the doubt imagines God has done to his compassion (282997). Standalone (the feared restraint).
v16: 'When the waters SAW (raah) you, O God, the waters saw you and were afraid' - the personified waters recoiling at the theophany; cosmic reaction, not human IB. Standalone (theophany).
v16: 'the waters SAW (raah) you and were afraid' - the doubled seeing of the recoiling waters; theophany image. Standalone.
be in anguish / afraid (chul - the waters were afraid)
v16: 'the waters saw you and were AFRAID (chul); the deep trembled' - the sea writhing in dread at God's approach; the personified cosmos, not a human IB response. Standalone (theophany).
v16: 'the DEEP (tehom) trembled' - the primeval abyss quaking at God; theophany image of the Exodus sea. Standalone.
v16: 'the deep TREMBLED (ragaz)' - the quaking of the abyss before God; theophany, cosmic reaction. Standalone.
clouds (ab - the clouds poured out water)
v17: 'The CLOUDS (ab) poured out water' - the storm-theophany; God's coming in tempest. Standalone (theophany).
pour out (zaram - the clouds poured out water)
v17: 'the clouds POURED OUT (zaram) water' - the deluge of the theophany storm. Standalone.
thunder / voice (qol - the skies gave forth thunder)
v17: 'the skies gave forth THUNDER (qol)' - the voice of the storm-God; theophany image. Standalone.
v17: 'your ARROWS (chets) flashed on every side' - the lightning-bolts of God's storm-coming; theophany image. Standalone.
thunder / crash (qol - the crash of your thunder)
v18: 'The CRASH (qol) of your thunder was in the whirlwind' - the roar of the theophany. Standalone.
thunder (galgal/raam - the crash of your thunder)
v18: 'the crash of your THUNDER (raam)' - the pealing thunder of God's storm-advent; theophany. Standalone.
v18: 'was in the WHIRLWIND (galgal)' - the storm-wheel of the theophany. Standalone.
lightnings (baraq - your lightnings lit up the world)
v18: 'your LIGHTNINGS (baraq) lit up the world' - the flashing of God's storm; theophany image. Standalone.
tremble (ragaz - the earth trembled and shook)
v18: 'the earth TREMBLED (ragaz) and shook' - the quaking of the world at God's approach; theophany, cosmic reaction not human IB. Standalone.
v18: 'the earth trembled and SHOOK (raash)' - the convulsing earth of the theophany. Standalone.
way / path (derek - your way was through the sea)
v19: 'Your PATH (derek) was through the sea, your way through the great waters' - God's route through the Exodus sea; theophany image. Standalone.
v19: 'yet your FOOTPRINTS (aqeb) were unseen' - the untraceable tracks of God through the waters; the mystery of his hidden way. Standalone (image).
v20: 'You led your people like a FLOCK (tson)' - the shepherd-image of God's guidance through the wilderness; the people as his flock (the qualifier led, 282952). Standalone (image).
